title: No such container error message for non existing fabric cards with config reload/load_minigrph
author: mannytaheri
body:
#### Description
After a config reload or a config load_minigraph we see the following error messages in the syslog for non existing fabric cards:


ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd0 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd0/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd0")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd1/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd1")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd11 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd11/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd11")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd13 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd13/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd13")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd10 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd10/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd10")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd12 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd12/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd12")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd2 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd2/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd2")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd14 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd14/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd14")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd15 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd15/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd15")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd3 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd3/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd3")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss0 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss0/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss0")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss12 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss12/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss12")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss2 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss2/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss2")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss10 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss10/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss10")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss1/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss1")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss3 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss3/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss3")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss11 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss11/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss11")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss15 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss15/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss15")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss14 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss14/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss14")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for swss13 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/swss13/json: Not Found ("No such container: swss13")

This is also reproducible by trying to stop container for a non exiting fabric card 
admin@ixre-cpm-chassis19:~$ sudo systemctl stop syncd@1

From the syslog:
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd1/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd1")

```
admin@ixre-cpm-chassis19:~$ show chassis modules status 
        Name             Description    Physical-Slot    Oper-Status    Admin-Status       Serial
------------  ----------------------  ---------------  -------------  --------------  -----------

FABRIC-CARD0             Unavailable                1          Empty              up          N/A
FABRIC-CARD1             Unavailable                2          Empty              up          N/A
FABRIC-CARD2                    SFM3                3         Online              up  NS241860554
FABRIC-CARD3                    SFM4                4         Online              up  NS241460830
FABRIC-CARD4                    SFM5                5         Online              up  NS241460851
FABRIC-CARD5             Unavailable                6          Empty              up          N/A
FABRIC-CARD6             Unavailable                7          Empty              up          N/A
FABRIC-CARD7             Unavailable                8          Empty              up          N/A
```

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. do a config reload and check the syslog 
2. do a config load_minigraph and check the syslog
3. Issue command "sudo systemctl stop syncd@x"  for a non existing fabric card

#### Describe the results you received:
Saw the above error messages in the log

#### Describe the results you expected:
No Error message


#### Why I did it
After a config reload or a config load_minigraph we see the following error messages in the syslog for non existing fabric cards:
```
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd0 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd0/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd0")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd1/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd1")
```
On Sup, for non-existing Fabric slot, its related swss and syncd containers have not been created yet although its related services have been started.  

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
Added checking to the  docker_image_ctrl.j2 stop() method.  This change adds code to check if related container exists, then call container stop.  Otherwise, just log a message to indicate that "No such container".  Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/19765

#### How to verify it
1) execute "config reload" on SUP which contains empty Fabric slot.
2) The following related error message should not be seen in syslog
```
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd0 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd0/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd0")
ixre-cpm-chassis19 ERR container: docker cmd: stop for syncd1 failed with 404 Client Error for http+docker://localhost/v1.43/containers/syncd1/json: Not Found ("No such container: syncd1")
```
3) Instead, the following message should be shown for the related empty Fabric slot
```
2024 Sep 19 17:45:18.339106 ixre-cpm-chassis15 INFO swss.sh[2024819]: container stop swss0 -- No such container: swss0
2024 Sep 19 17:45:20.633519 ixre-cpm-chassis15 INFO syncd.sh[2025664]: container stop syncd0 -- No such container: syncd0
```
